messages.text: Buongiorno, benvenuto alla Galleria d'Arte. Desidera visitare la mostra?
messages.english: Good morning, welcome to the Art Gallery. Would you like to visit the exhibition?

choices.text: Buongiorno, sì. Quanto costa il biglietto d'ingresso?
choices.feedback: Perfect. Asking about the price is a natural next step.
choices.english: Good morning, yes. How much is the entrance ticket?

choices.text: Buongiorno, no. Dov'è la fermata dell'autobus?
choices.feedback: You are already inside the gallery, why ask for the bus?
choices.english: Good morning, no. Where is the bus stop?

choices.text: Ciao, vorrei comprare un chilo di mele rosse.
choices.feedback: This is a gallery, not a grocery store!
choices.english: Hi, I'd like to buy a kilo of red apples.

messages.text: Il biglietto intero costa dodici euro. È uno studente?
messages.english: The full-price ticket costs twelve euros. Are you a student?

choices.text: Sì, sono uno studente. C'è uno sconto per me?
choices.feedback: Correct. Students usually get a discount in Italy.
choices.english: Yes, I am a student. Is there a discount for me?

choices.text: No, non sono uno studente. Posso avere un caffè?
choices.feedback: The question was about being a student, not coffee.
choices.english: No, I'm not a student. Can I have a coffee?

choices.text: Sì, studio musica. Dove posso suonare il piano?
choices.feedback: The gallery is for viewing art, not playing piano.
choices.english: Yes, I study music. Where can I play the piano?

messages.text: Certamente. Per gli studenti il prezzo è di otto euro.
messages.english: Certainly. For students, the price is eight euros.

choices.text: Ottimo, ecco otto euro. Posso avere il biglietto?
choices.feedback: Good. You are completing the transaction.
choices.english: Great, here is eight euros. Can I have the ticket?

choices.text: Troppo caro. Posso pagare solo due euro oggi?
choices.feedback: Prices are usually fixed in galleries.
choices.english: Too expensive. Can I only pay two euros today?

choices.text: Va bene, ma voglio anche un biglietto per il treno.
choices.feedback: Galleries do not sell train tickets.
choices.english: Okay, but I also want a train ticket.

messages.text: Ecco il suo biglietto. La mostra inizia nella sala a sinistra.
messages.english: Here is your ticket. The exhibition starts in the room on the left.

choices.text: Grazie mille. C'è una mappa della galleria?
choices.feedback: Helpful to ask for a map to navigate the space.
choices.english: Thank you very much. Is there a map of the gallery?

choices.text: Grazie. Dove posso comprare delle scarpe nuove?
choices.feedback: This is not a shopping mall.
choices.english: Thanks. Where can I buy new shoes?

choices.text: Va bene. Posso mangiare un panino in quella sala?
choices.feedback: Eating is generally forbidden inside art galleries.
choices.english: Okay. Can I eat a sandwich in that room?

messages.text: Sì, ecco una piccola mappa. La guida audio è gratuita.
messages.english: Yes, here is a small map. The audio guide is free.

choices.text: Molto gentile. Come funziona la guida audio?
choices.feedback: A natural follow-up question about the service.
choices.english: Very kind. How does the audio guide work?

choices.text: Grazie. Posso avere una guida per il museo?
choices.feedback: He just gave you one!
choices.english: Thanks. Can I have a guide for the museum?

choices.text: Va bene. La guida parla anche la lingua russa?
choices.feedback: Focus on how it works first.
choices.english: Okay. Does the guide also speak Russian?

messages.text: Deve solo digitare il numero dell'opera sulla tastiera.
messages.english: You just need to type the number of the artwork on the keypad.

choices.text: Capisco, grazie. È molto semplice da usare.
choices.feedback: Acknowledging the explanation is polite.
choices.english: I see, thanks. It is very simple to use.

choices.text: Non capisco. Posso avere un telecomando?
choices.feedback: The keypad is the way it works.
choices.english: I don't understand. Can I have a remote control?

choices.text: Va bene. Dove posso trovare un tecnico?
choices.feedback: You don't need a technician yet.
choices.english: Okay. Where can I find a technician?

messages.text: Esatto. Posso fare altro per aiutarla prima di iniziare?
messages.english: Exactly. Can I do anything else to help you before you start?

choices.text: Sì, un'ultima cosa. Si possono fare foto?
choices.feedback: Photography rules are important in galleries.
choices.english: Yes, one last thing. Can one take photos?

choices.text: No, grazie. Voglio solo dormire un po'.
choices.feedback: A gallery is not a place for a nap.
choices.english: No, thanks. I just want to sleep a bit.

choices.text: Sì, vorrei sapere l'orario del volo.
choices.feedback: Airport information is not available here.
choices.english: Yes, I'd like to know the flight schedule.

messages.text: Sì, ma solo senza flash per non rovinare i quadri.
messages.english: Yes, but only without flash so as not to ruin the paintings.

choices.text: Va bene, nessun problema. Niente flash allora.
choices.feedback: Accepting the rules shows you understand.
choices.english: Okay, no problem. No flash then.

choices.text: Peccato, io voglio usare un flash molto forte.
choices.feedback: That would damage the artwork and bother others.
choices.english: Too bad, I want to use a very strong flash.

choices.text: Perché no? La luce fa bene ai colori.
choices.feedback: Actually, intense light damages pigments.
choices.english: Why not? Light is good for colors.

messages.text: La ringrazio per la collaborazione. Buona visita!
messages.english: Thank you for your cooperation. Enjoy your visit!

choices.text: Grazie mille, a più tardi. Buona giornata!
choices.feedback: A polite way to end the conversation.
choices.english: Thank you very much, see you later. Have a good day!

choices.text: Grazie. Dove posso trovare l'uscita adesso?
choices.feedback: You haven't even started your visit yet!
choices.english: Thanks. Where can I find the exit now?

choices.text: Prego. Mi porta un bicchiere d'acqua?
choices.feedback: The host is a receptionist, not a waiter.
choices.english: You're welcome. Can you bring me a glass of water?

messages.text: Arrivederci! Si ricordi di spegnere il cellulare.
messages.english: Goodbye! Remember to turn off your cell phone.

choices.text: Certamente, lo spengo subito. Arrivederci!
choices.feedback: Good conclusion, following the final instruction.
choices.english: Certainly, I'll turn it off right away. Goodbye!

choices.text: No, voglio parlare al telefono ad alta voce.
choices.feedback: That would be very rude in a quiet gallery.
choices.english: No, I want to talk on the phone loudly.

choices.text: Va bene. Mi serve un caricabatterie.
choices.feedback: He asked you to turn it off, not charge it.
choices.english: Okay. I need a charger.

messages.text: Vedo che osserva questo quadro da molto tempo. Le piace?
messages.english: I see you've been looking at this painting for a long time. Do you like it?

choices.text: Sì, molto. Chi è l'artista che ha dipinto questo?
choices.feedback: Good question to start learning about the work.
choices.english: Yes, very much. Who is the artist who painted this?

choices.text: No, è brutto. Chi ha fatto questo errore?
choices.feedback: A bit rude for an art gallery visitor.
choices.english: No, it's ugly. Who made this mistake?

choices.text: Forse. Mi sa dire che ore sono adesso?
choices.feedback: Stay focused on the painting you are looking at.
choices.english: Maybe. Can you tell me what time it is now?

messages.text: È un'opera di un giovane pittore italiano di Roma.
messages.english: It is a work by a young Italian painter from Rome.

choices.text: Interessante. Come si chiama questo pittore?
choices.feedback: Asking for the name is the logical follow-up.
choices.english: Interesting. What is this painter's name?

choices.text: Capisco. Roma è una città molto grande.
choices.feedback: True, but not relevant to the artist's identity.
choices.english: I see. Rome is a very large city.

choices.text: Bello. Quanti anni ha questo pittore?
choices.feedback: The name is more important than the exact age.
choices.english: Nice. How old is this painter?

messages.text: Si chiama Marco Rossi. È molto famoso in Italia.
messages.english: His name is Marco Rossi. He is very famous in Italy.

choices.text: Ah, ho già sentito questo nome. È bravo.
choices.feedback: Showing some familiarity or appreciation.
choices.english: Ah, I've already heard this name. He's good.

choices.text: Marco Rossi? È un nome molto comune.
choices.feedback: A bit dismissive of the artist.
choices.english: Marco Rossi? It's a very common name.

choices.text: Bene. Lui gioca anche a calcio?
choices.feedback: You are talking about a painter, not a player.
choices.english: Good. Does he also play soccer?

messages.text: Sì, ha vinto molti premi importanti recentemente.
messages.english: Yes, he has won many important awards recently.

choices.text: Qual è il tema principale delle sue opere?
choices.feedback: Deepening the conversation about the art itself.
choices.english: What is the main theme of his works?

choices.text: Bene. Quanto ha vinto in denaro?
choices.feedback: Focusing on money is not very artistic.
choices.english: Good. How much money did he win?

choices.text: Ah. Lui ha anche un cane o un gatto?
choices.feedback: Irrelevant personal detail about the artist.
choices.english: Ah. Does he also have a dog or a cat?

messages.text: Lui dipinge spesso la natura e i paesaggi urbani.
messages.english: He often paints nature and urban landscapes.

choices.text: Si vede. I colori che usa sono molto vivaci.
choices.feedback: Observing the visual elements of the work.
choices.english: It shows. The colors he uses are very bright.

choices.text: Capisco. Io preferisco mangiare la frutta.
choices.feedback: The conversation is about painting themes.
choices.english: I see. I prefer to eat fruit.

choices.text: Va bene. Dove posso comprare una pianta?
choices.feedback: Nature in art is different from a flower shop.
choices.english: Okay. Where can I buy a plant?

messages.text: Usa una tecnica particolare per dare luce al quadro.
messages.english: He uses a particular technique to give light to the painting.

choices.text: Davvero? Mi sembra una tecnica molto difficile.
choices.feedback: Engaging with the technical aspect mentioned.
choices.english: Really? It seems like a very difficult technique to me.

choices.text: No, è facile. Anche io posso farlo.
choices.feedback: Artistic techniques often require years of study.
choices.english: No, it's easy. I can do it too.

choices.text: Chiaro. La luce della stanza è troppo forte.
choices.feedback: He was talking about light *within* the painting.
choices.english: Clear. The light in the room is too strong.

messages.text: Ha studiato molti anni all'Accademia di Belle Arti.
messages.english: He studied for many years at the Academy of Fine Arts.

choices.text: Si vede che ha una grande preparazione tecnica.
choices.feedback: Validating the artist's professional background.
choices.english: You can see that he has a great technical background.

choices.text: Studiare è noioso. Io preferisco dormire.
choices.feedback: Not a very constructive comment about art.
choices.english: Studying is boring. I prefer to sleep.

choices.text: Va bene. Dov'è la scuola di cucina?
choices.feedback: Wrong kind of academy.
choices.english: Okay. Where is the cooking school?

messages.text: Oltre a questo quadro, abbiamo altre cinque sue opere.
messages.english: In addition to this painting, we have five other works of his.

choices.text: Dove posso vedere le altre sue opere?
choices.feedback: Natural interest in seeing more of the same artist.
choices.english: Where can I see his other works?

choices.text: Cinque sono troppe. Ne voglio vedere solo una.
choices.feedback: You can choose what to look at, but five is a small set.
choices.english: Five are too many. I only want to see one.

choices.text: Va bene. Mi servono cinque biglietti.
choices.feedback: You were talking about artworks, not tickets.
choices.english: Okay. I need five tickets.

messages.text: Sono tutte esposte nella sala dedicata agli emergenti.
messages.english: They are all on display in the room dedicated to emerging artists.

choices.text: Grazie dell'informazione. Vado subito a vederle.
choices.feedback: A positive way to continue the visit.
choices.english: Thanks for the information. I'm going to see them right away.

choices.text: No, non voglio vederle. Sono stanco.
choices.feedback: You can sit down, but why be so negative?
choices.english: No, I don't want to see them. I'm tired.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno degli emergenti?
choices.feedback: The room is for art, not a special bathroom.
choices.english: Where is the bathroom for the emerging ones?

messages.text: Prego. Se vuole, c'è anche il catalogo dell'artista.
messages.english: You're welcome. If you want, there's also the artist's catalog.

choices.text: Grazie, darò un'occhiata al catalogo più tardi.
choices.feedback: Polite conclusion to the exchange.
choices.english: Thanks, I'll take a look at the catalog later.

choices.text: Il catalogo è gratis? Altrimenti non lo voglio.
choices.feedback: A bit blunt. Some catalogs are free, some aren't.
choices.english: Is the catalog free? Otherwise, I don't want it.

choices.text: Va bene. Mi porti un catalogo di macchine.
choices.feedback: Wrong domain!
choices.english: Okay. Bring me a car catalog.

conversations.title: Gli Stili d'Arte
conversations.description: Discuti i diversi stili artistici presenti nella galleria.

messages.text: In questa galleria abbiamo sia arte classica che moderna.
messages.english: In this gallery, we have both classical and modern art.

choices.text: Quale stile preferisce lei personalmente?
choices.feedback: A nice way to engage the host in conversation.
choices.english: Which style do you personally prefer?

choices.text: Quale film danno oggi al cinema?
choices.feedback: Wrong scenario!
choices.english: What movie is playing at the cinema today?

choices.text: Mi piace il calcio moderno.
choices.feedback: Not the kind of 'modern' we are talking about.
choices.english: I like modern soccer.

messages.text: Io amo l'arte moderna per i suoi colori astratti.
messages.english: I love modern art for its abstract colors.

choices.text: Io invece preferisco lo stile classico e reale.
choices.feedback: Expressing a different but valid preference.
choices.english: I, on the other hand, prefer the classical and realistic style.

choices.text: L'arte astratta è solo un insieme di macchie.
choices.feedback: A very narrow view of abstract art.
choices.english: Abstract art is just a collection of spots.

choices.text: Va bene. Dove posso comprare dei colori?
choices.feedback: The host is sharing an opinion, not selling supplies.
choices.english: Okay. Where can I buy some colors?

messages.text: Capisco. I quadri classici sono molto dettagliati.
messages.english: I understand. Classical paintings are very detailed.

choices.text: Sì, sembrano quasi delle fotografie vere.
choices.feedback: Good observation about classical realism.
choices.english: Yes, they look almost like real photographs.

choices.text: No, sono noiosi e troppo scuri.
choices.feedback: Classical art can be very vibrant too.
choices.english: No, they are boring and too dark.

choices.text: Bene. Dove posso fare una fotografia?
choices.feedback: The host was using a metaphor, not suggesting a photo.
choices.english: Good. Where can I take a photograph?

messages.text: Esatto. L'arte moderna invece cerca di dare emozioni.
messages.english: Exactly. Modern art, on the other hand, tries to evoke emotions.

choices.text: È vero, alcuni quadri moderni sono molto forti.
choices.feedback: Agreeing and adding to the conversation.
choices.english: It's true, some modern paintings are very strong.

choices.text: Le emozioni sono solo per i film tristi.
choices.feedback: Art of all kinds is deeply connected to emotion.
choices.english: Emotions are only for sad movies.

choices.text: Va bene. Dov'è la sala della rabbia?
choices.feedback: Not a standard room in a gallery.
choices.english: Okay. Where is the anger room?

messages.text: Abbiamo una sala intera dedicata al futurismo.
messages.english: We have an entire room dedicated to Futurism.

choices.text: Il futurismo è uno stile molto dinamico, vero?
choices.feedback: Showing some knowledge of art history.
choices.english: Futurism is a very dynamic style, right?

choices.text: Il futuro è domani. Cosa mangiamo?
choices.feedback: Futurism is an art movement, not a menu.
choices.english: The future is tomorrow. What are we eating?

choices.text: Voglio andare nel futuro con una macchina.
choices.feedback: This is art, not science fiction.
choices.english: I want to go into the future with a machine.

messages.text: Sì, parla di velocità, macchine e progresso.
messages.english: Yes, it's about speed, cars, and progress.

choices.text: Molto interessante. Dove si trova questa sala?
choices.feedback: Wanting to visit the specific section mentioned.
choices.english: Very interesting. Where is this room located?

choices.text: Le macchine sono troppo veloci e pericolose.
choices.feedback: The host is describing art themes, not traffic.
choices.english: Cars are too fast and dangerous.

choices.text: Va bene. Quanto corre la sua auto?
choices.feedback: Irrelevant personal question.
choices.english: Okay. How fast does your car go?

messages.text: È al piano superiore, vicino alle sculture.
messages.english: It's on the upper floor, near the sculptures.

choices.text: Ci sono anche sculture moderne in quella sala?
choices.feedback: Asking for clarification about the collection.
choices.english: Are there also modern sculptures in that room?

choices.text: Le sculture sono fatte di cioccolato?
choices.feedback: Usually stone, bronze, or wood, not candy.
choices.english: Are the sculptures made of chocolate?

choices.text: Va bene. C'è l'ascensore per salire?
choices.feedback: Valid question, but the art question is better here.
choices.english: Okay. Is there an elevator to go up?

messages.text: Sì, ci sono opere in bronzo e in marmo.
messages.english: Yes, there are works in bronze and marble.

choices.text: Il marmo è un materiale molto classico.
choices.feedback: Connecting materials to styles correctly.
choices.english: Marble is a very classical material.

choices.text: Il bronzo serve per fare le medaglie.
choices.feedback: Also used for statues for thousands of years.
choices.english: Bronze is used for making medals.

choices.text: Va bene. Posso avere un pezzo di marmo?
choices.feedback: Artworks are not for taking pieces from!
choices.english: Okay. Can I have a piece of marble?

messages.text: Sì, ma gli artisti moderni lo usano in modo nuovo.
messages.english: Yes, but modern artists use it in a new way.

choices.text: Capisco. Mi piace questo contrasto tra vecchio e nuovo.
choices.feedback: Showing appreciation for the artistic approach.
choices.english: I see. I like this contrast between old and new.

choices.text: Nuovo è meglio di vecchio sempre.
choices.feedback: A very subjective and simplistic view.
choices.english: New is always better than old.

choices.text: Va bene. Dove posso comprare un telefono nuovo?
choices.feedback: Wrong domain!
choices.english: Okay. Where can I buy a new phone?

messages.text: Spero che la visita le piaccia molto allora.
messages.english: I hope you enjoy your visit very much then.

choices.text: Sicuramente. Grazie dei consigli, a presto!
choices.feedback: Polite end to the discussion about styles.
choices.english: Definitely. Thanks for the advice, see you soon!

choices.text: Non credo. Questa galleria è troppo grande.
choices.feedback: Size is usually a good thing for a gallery!
choices.english: I don't think so. This gallery is too big.

choices.text: Va bene. Mi porti un gelato adesso.
choices.feedback: There might be a cafe, but the host isn't serving.
choices.english: Okay. Bring me an ice cream now.

conversations.title: Prezzi e Materiali
conversations.description: Chiedi informazioni sui materiali e sui prezzi delle opere in vendita.

messages.text: Alcune opere in questa sala sono in vendita. Le interessa?
messages.english: Some works in this room are for sale. Are you interested?

choices.text: Sì, forse. Quel quadro piccolo quanto costa?
choices.feedback: Direct and appropriate question about price.
choices.english: Yes, maybe. How much is that small painting?

choices.text: No, io non ho mai soldi con me.
choices.feedback: A bit too personal and negative.
choices.english: No, I never have money with me.

choices.text: Sì, vorrei comprare tutta la galleria.
choices.feedback: That would be extremely expensive!
choices.english: Yes, I'd like to buy the whole gallery.

messages.text: Quello costa cinquecento euro. È un olio su tela.
messages.english: That one costs five hundred euros. It's an oil on canvas.

choices.text: Bello. E quello vicino, fatto con l'acquerello?
choices.feedback: Showing interest in different materials.
choices.english: Nice. And the one nearby, made with watercolor?

choices.text: Cinquecento euro? È troppo per un po' di olio.
choices.feedback: Art prices include the skill, not just the oil.
choices.english: Five hundred euros? That's too much for a bit of oil.

choices.text: Va bene. L'olio serve per cucinare la pasta?
choices.feedback: Painting oil is different from olive oil!
choices.english: Okay. Is the oil used for cooking pasta?

messages.text: L'acquerello costa meno, circa duecento euro.
messages.english: The watercolor costs less, about two hundred euros.

choices.text: Perché c'è questa differenza di prezzo?
choices.feedback: A smart question about the art market.
choices.english: Why is there this price difference?

choices.text: Duecento euro sono pochi. Ne voglio dieci.
choices.feedback: Artworks are unique, you can't just order ten.
choices.english: Two hundred euros are few. I want ten.

choices.text: Va bene. Posso avere un bicchiere d'acqua?
choices.feedback: Watercolor is a technique, not a drink.
choices.english: Okay. Can I have a glass of water?

messages.text: L'olio richiede più tempo e materiali più costosi.
messages.english: Oil requires more time and more expensive materials.

choices.text: Capisco. L'acquerello invece è più veloce?
choices.feedback: Logical deduction based on the host's reply.
choices.english: I see. Is watercolor faster, then?

choices.text: Il tempo è denaro. Io sono un uomo d'affari.
choices.feedback: A bit arrogant for a casual visitor.
choices.english: Time is money. I am a businessman.

choices.text: Va bene. Dove posso comprare un orologio?
choices.feedback: Wrong domain!
choices.english: Okay. Where can I buy a watch?

messages.text: Sì, ma è anche molto difficile perché non puoi sbagliare.
messages.english: Yes, but it's also very difficult because you can't make mistakes.

choices.text: È vero, l'acquerello è una tecnica molto delicata.
choices.feedback: Showing understanding of the technical challenge.
choices.english: It's true, watercolor is a very delicate technique.

choices.text: Io non sbaglio mai. Sono un genio.
choices.feedback: Confidence is good, but this is a bit much.
choices.english: I never make mistakes. I am a genius.

choices.text: Va bene. Dove posso comprare una gomma?
choices.feedback: You can't erase watercolor easily!
choices.english: Okay. Where can I buy an eraser?

messages.text: Esatto. Le interessa comprare l'opera ad olio?
messages.english: Exactly. Are you interested in buying the oil painting?

choices.text: Ci devo pensare. Posso avere un catalogo?
choices.feedback: A common and polite way to defer a big purchase.
choices.english: I need to think about it. Can I have a catalog?

choices.text: Sì, la prendo subito. Ecco la mia carta.
choices.feedback: A bit fast, but possible. The catalog is safer.
choices.english: Yes, I'll take it right away. Here is my card.

choices.text: No, preferisco comprare una macchina.
choices.feedback: Wrong domain!
choices.english: No, I prefer to buy a car.

messages.text: Certamente, il catalogo costa quindici euro.
messages.english: Certainly, the catalog costs fifteen euros.

choices.text: Va bene, prendo il catalogo per adesso.
choices.feedback: Deciding on a smaller purchase is reasonable.
choices.english: Okay, I'll take the catalog for now.

choices.text: Quindici euro per un libro? È follia!
choices.feedback: Art catalogs are often expensive to produce.
choices.english: Fifteen euros for a book? It's madness!

choices.text: Va bene. Posso avere un catalogo di vestiti?
choices.feedback: This is an art gallery, not a fashion shop.
choices.english: Okay. Can I have a clothing catalog?

messages.text: Ottima scelta. Nel catalogo ci sono tutte le foto.
messages.english: Great choice. All the photos are in the catalog.

choices.text: Ci sono anche le biografie degli artisti?
choices.feedback: Good question about the content of the catalog.
choices.english: Are there also biographies of the artists?

choices.text: Le foto sono a colori o in bianco e nero?
choices.feedback: Most art catalogs are in full color.
choices.english: Are the photos in color or in black and white?

choices.text: Va bene. Mi serve una foto per il passaporto.
choices.feedback: Wrong kind of photo!
choices.english: Okay. I need a passport photo.

messages.text: Sì, c'è una sezione dedicata alla vita di ognuno.
messages.english: Yes, there is a section dedicated to the life of each one.

choices.text: Perfetto, lo compro volentieri allora. Grazie.
choices.feedback: Completing the purchase of the catalog.
choices.english: Perfect, I'll gladly buy it then. Thanks.

choices.text: La vita è breve. Non voglio leggere nulla.
choices.feedback: A bit nihilistic for an art enthusiast.
choices.english: Life is short. I don't want to read anything.

choices.text: Va bene. Dov'è la sezione dei dolci?
choices.feedback: Wrong domain!
choices.english: Okay. Where is the dessert section?

messages.text: Grazie a lei. Le porto subito il catalogo alla cassa.
messages.english: Thank you. I'll bring the catalog to the counter for you right away.

choices.text: Grazie mille, arrivederci e buona giornata!
choices.feedback: Polite ending to the transaction.
choices.english: Thank you very much, goodbye and have a good day!

choices.text: Va bene. Posso avere anche un sacchetto?
choices.feedback: He's already helping you at the counter.
choices.english: Okay. Can I also have a bag?

choices.text: Arrivederci. Mi serve un taxi adesso.
choices.feedback: The host can't help with that immediately.
choices.english: Goodbye. I need a taxi now.
